chimpu.name: Chimpu
chimpu.about:
Chimpu sits at the northern entry to Itanagar along NH-52A, where the Chimpu River meets the Senki River. The capital's municipal ward list groups it with a cluster of government offices, research and forest institutions and an armed police headquarters, so a good part of the land is official campus and staff quarters rather than open private housing. Chimpu also has its own police station within the capital police.

For a tutor, that means many homes here are inside government staff colonies, where a visitor may be asked to give a name at the gate, so it helps to share the tutor's details with the family in advance. Private houses on the slopes around the campuses usually allow doorstep arrival. The Chandranagar side of the city lies just beyond Chimpu along the highway. Morning and evening office traffic on the highway is worth avoiding when fixing a slot, and in heavy monsoon rain it is sensible to allow extra time or switch that day's class online. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

chandranagar.name: Chandranagar
chandranagar.about:
Chandranagar is where the Itanagar municipal area begins on the city's northern side, and the capital complex is described as stretching from Chandranagar to Nirjuli. The official ward schedule lists Chandranagar Market, Chandranagar Colony, Chandranagar Forest Colony and a Police Colony here, along with an industrial estate and a power house on the low ground beside the Senki River, so homes sit next to a working market and some light industry.

Most families live either in the colonies above the highway or in houses on the lanes running down towards the river. Government colonies may ask visitors to sign in, while private houses generally allow a tutor to walk straight to the door. Vivek Vihar adjoins it on one side and the Ganga Village road lies on the other, so tutors living in those areas can reach Chandranagar easily. The market end of NH-52A gets busy at school closing time and in the evening, so a late-afternoon or weekend slot often works better. Specialist subjects can be taken online if no local tutor fits the timetable. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

vivek-vihar-itanagar.name: Vivek Vihar (Itanagar)
vivek-vihar-itanagar.about:
Vivek Vihar is a residential part of north Itanagar between NH-52A and the Senki River, with its own branch post office. The official ward schedule places Minister Colony, Holongi Market and the hilltop part of Vivek Vihar here, along with a college area and a polytechnic, while the Vivek Vihar police point and Chandranagar Colony mark its lower edge. The Jollang Road climbs from this side towards Jollang village.

Housing is a mix of government quarters, officers' colonies and independent houses on the hillside, with the hilltop part reached by internal roads off the highway. In houses, tutors can usually park outside and go straight in; in the official colonies it is courteous to tell the family the tutor's name and arrival time so the gate is not a delay. Chandranagar and the Ganga Market side are the nearest neighbours, so tutors from either can cover Vivek Vihar. On rainy days the hill roads are slower, so families often keep a fixed online slot as a backup. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

ganga-market.name: Ganga Market
ganga-market.about:
Ganga Market is one of Itanagar's main shopping areas on NH-52A, with banks, hotels, a shared-taxi counter and an auto stand. The official ward schedule groups it with the helipad area, Doni Colony and the housing colony on the Jollang road, while a neighbouring ward covers H Sector, H Sector Tinali, the F and G Sectors and the Old Ganga Market.

Homes here range from flats above shops on the main road to independent houses and government quarters in the sectors and colonies behind it. With the shared-taxi counter and the auto stand at the market, a tutor who does not drive can arrive by shared taxi or auto and walk the last stretch into the sector. Market traffic builds up in the evening, so an earlier slot or a weekend morning is easier for both sides. Vivek Vihar, Chandranagar and E-Sector are close by for tutors already working in the area. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

niti-vihar.name: Niti Vihar
niti-vihar.about:
Niti Vihar is a largely residential part of central Itanagar with its own police station and a small market. The official ward schedule lists Niti Vihar Market, a staff colony, the minister bungalow area, Senki Park, the UD and PHE colonies and Lobi Colony across its two wards, with Panchali and the Museum Colony just above it on the ridge. Much of the housing is government quarters and official bungalows, with private houses on the surrounding slopes.

For a home tutor this is a quiet area to work in, but the official compounds often have a gate where visitors give their name, so families usually inform the guard in advance. Private houses on the link roads allow doorstep arrival, and parking is easier than in the busier market sectors. Bank Tinali and the Zero Point side are the nearest commercial areas, so a tutor can combine visits across them. Because the roads here wind up the hillside, families often prefer a fixed weekly slot, with an online class kept ready for days of heavy rain. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bank-tinali.name: Bank Tinali
bank-tinali.about:
Bank Tinali is a busy junction and market area in central Itanagar, named in the official ward schedule alongside C-II Sector, IG Park, the Forest Colony and the power house. Several banks have branches here, and the inner road from the junction runs past the market towards Niti Vihar. The adjoining ward covers the O Point market area, Panchali and the Museum Colony.

Families in Bank Tinali live in flats above shops, in older houses on the side lanes and in government quarters in C-II Sector and the Forest Colony. A tutor visiting a house can usually walk in from the lane, while official colonies may ask for a name at the gate. The junction and the highway nearby are among the busiest stretches of the city at school and office closing time, so tutors often choose a slot after the evening rush or on weekends. E-Sector, Niti Vihar and the Zero Point side are all close, so tutors from those areas commonly take students here too. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

e-sector-itanagar.name: E-Sector (Itanagar)
e-sector-itanagar.about:
E-Sector lies along NH-52A opposite the state's Civil Secretariat, at the administrative heart of Itanagar. The official ward schedule places Abo Tani Colony, the Apex Bank Colony, F Sector and the E Sector side opposite the Secretariat in one ward, and the Secretariat complex, DD Colony and part of ESS Sector in the next, so offices, banks and government housing all sit close together.

Most families here live in government quarters, officers' colonies and independent houses on the slopes above and below the highway. Visitors to official colonies may be asked to sign in, while private houses usually allow a tutor straight to the door. Office hours make the highway in front of the Secretariat busy in the morning and late afternoon, so tuition slots in the early evening or on weekends tend to run more smoothly. Ganga Market lies on one side and Bank Tinali and C-Sector on the other, which puts E-Sector within easy reach of tutors from across central Itanagar. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

c-sector-itanagar.name: C-Sector (Itanagar)
c-sector-itanagar.about:
C-Sector is a central Itanagar sector of offices, hotels and housing on the highway towards Naharlagun. The official ward schedule lists C Sector, the C Sector officers' colony, the circuit house, a police station, a fire station, several state government offices and the Gandhi Market area here, with D Sector, the Postal Colony and the left part of ESS Sector in the neighbouring ward. A daily market road runs up from the highway into the sector.

Families live in officers' colonies, government quarters and independent houses climbing the ridge above the market. For a tutor, independent houses mean doorstep arrival, while the official colonies may ask for a name at the gate. Parking can be tight near Gandhi Market, so a tutor on a two-wheeler or arriving by shared taxi often finds it easier. Office traffic on the highway is heaviest at the start and end of the working day, so an evening or weekend slot helps. Zero Point, E-Sector and Bank Tinali are all close neighbours. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

zero-point.name: Zero Point and P-Sector
zero-point.about:
Zero Point is a market junction on NH-52A at the eastern end of central Itanagar, and the ward schedule groups it with P Sector, the upper part of Gandhi Market and a broadcasting staff colony. Further along the highway towards Naharlagun lie Mithun Gate, A Sector, B Sector and the Raj Bhawan complex on the ridge, near the eastern gate of the medieval brick Ita Fort. Adi Basti, Nyokum Lapang and the area known as 6th Mile lie on the hillside beyond.

Housing ranges from government quarters in the lettered sectors to independent houses and older settlements on the slopes. Tutors visiting a house usually go straight to the door, while official quarters may ask for a name at the entrance. Zero Point sits on the main highway between Itanagar and Naharlagun, so a tutor coming from either town can get down at the junction and walk or take an auto for the last stretch. C-Sector and Papu Nallah are the nearest neighbours on either side. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

papu-nallah.name: Papu Nallah
papu-nallah.about:
Papu Nallah lies on NH-52A between Itanagar and Naharlagun and takes its name from the stream that runs through it. The official ward schedule lists Papu Nallah, the Press Colony, Papu Colony and Papu Hill in this ward, and the area has its own police station, named Papu Hills, within the capital police. Its eastern edge reaches the junction where the Yupia road leaves the highway.

Homes are mostly independent houses and small colonies on the hillside on both sides of the highway, with some government housing. This makes most tuition visits a doorstep arrival, and a tutor travelling by shared taxi between the two towns can get down on the highway and walk in. Because Papu Nallah sits midway, tutors from both Itanagar's Zero Point side and Naharlagun's Barapani side can cover it. The highway carries through traffic between the two towns at peak hours, so slots after the evening rush tend to be calmer, and online classes are a practical fallback on days of heavy rain. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

barapani.name: Barapani
barapani.about:
Barapani is the western entry to Naharlagun on NH-52A, near where the Pachin River runs alongside the town. The official ward schedule lists Pachin Colony, the Popu village and Pachin Colony area and Barapani in one ward, and Barapani D Sector, C Sector, the Barapani market area and Dokum Colony, around the Deputy Commissioner's office, in the next. The junction for the Yupia road lies on its Itanagar side.

Families live in independent houses, government quarters and colonies on either side of the highway and along the river. With a market, offices and housing together, a tutor can reach most homes on foot after getting off a shared taxi at the market, and independent houses mean doorstep arrival. Papu Nallah adjoins it towards Itanagar, and Polo Colony and central Naharlagun lie just beyond, so tutors living in Naharlagun can cover Barapani easily. The market stretch of the highway is busiest in the evening, so earlier or weekend slots are easier. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

polo-colony.name: Polo Colony
polo-colony.about:
Polo Colony is a residential part of Naharlagun on the slopes above the Lagun and Pachin rivers, near Polo Park, which the capital district names as one of the area's popular visitor places. The official ward schedule lists Polo Colony, the transport colony, Down Polo Colony, Upper D Sector and the D Sector court area across two wards, with the dam site colony nearby.

Housing is largely government quarters and independent houses on roads that rise from the main town. Tutors visiting houses here usually arrive at the door, while official colonies may ask for a name at the entrance, so it helps for the family to mention the tutor in advance. A tutor on foot may prefer an auto for the last stretch from central Naharlagun or Barapani. Weekend mornings and early evenings suit most families, and online classes are a useful option on days of heavy monsoon rain. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

naharlagun.name: Naharlagun
naharlagun.about:
Naharlagun is the second town of the capital region, a foothill town administered as part of the Itanagar Capital Complex and home to many government departments. Its central wards, as listed in the official schedule, include A Sector, B Sector, Prem Nagar, the daily market area and the industrial area, while E Sector, F Sector, G Sector, G Extension, Rakap Colony, the dam site and an upper police colony climb the hill on the eastern side. Naharlagun railway station, opened in April 2014, is the first major rail head in Arunachal Pradesh and has trains to Guwahati and Delhi.

Homes are a mix of government quarters, independent houses and buildings around the market. Most tuition visits are doorstep arrivals, though official colonies may ask for a name at the gate. G Extension and E Sector are reached by link roads off the highway, so tutors coming by shared taxi often take an auto from the daily market. The market junction is busy in the evening, so families often fix slots after the rush or on weekends. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

nirjuli.name: Nirjuli
nirjuli.about:
Nirjuli is a town in Papum Pare district on NH-415 (formerly NH-52A), beyond Naharlagun on the road towards Banderdewa and Assam. The Par and Dikrong rivers flow through the area. It combines housing with a large technical institute campus divided by the highway, government offices and an industrial area, and the official ward schedule lists the whole Nirjuli complex as one ward of the capital's municipal area. Nirjuli has its own police station within the capital police.

Families live in institute and government staff quarters, colonies and independent houses near the highway. Campus and staff housing usually has a gate where visitors register, so the family should pass on the tutor's name in advance; private houses allow doorstep arrival. Naharlagun is the nearest town for shopping and transport, and many tutors living there can cover Nirjuli on the same day as Naharlagun students. For specialist subjects, an online tutor from elsewhere can fill the gap if no local tutor is free. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

banderdewa.name: Banderdewa
banderdewa.about:
Banderdewa is a town in the Itanagar Capital Region on the bank of the Dikrong River, right at the border with Assam. NH-415 starts here and links Itanagar and Naharlagun with Assam, and NH-15 also passes through the town. The official ward schedule lists the Banderdewa market area, a forest range office, Anya Colony, transport and workshop staff housing, warehouses and a government complex at Karsingsa within the town's ward.

Banderdewa is the main check gate between Arunachal Pradesh and Assam, so a tutor travelling in from outside the state should check the official rules, as visitors from outside may need a permit. Homes are largely government staff quarters and independent houses, so tutors usually reach the door directly or sign in at a staff colony gate. Nirjuli is the nearest neighbour towards the capital. As a smaller town, many families here combine a home tutor for core subjects with online classes for the rest. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

doimukh.name: Doimukh
doimukh.about:
Doimukh is a small town in Papum Pare district and a separate administrative circle from the capital complex circles of Itanagar, Naharlagun and Banderdewa. It is a subdivision and a block of the district, and it gives its name to an assembly constituency. NH-415, the highway that links the capital region with Assam, lists Doimukh among the main places it serves.

As a smaller town, Doimukh has fewer local home tutors than Itanagar or Naharlagun, so families usually look for a tutor from the nearby towns of the capital region or combine home visits with online classes. Where the home is an independent house, a tutor can generally come straight to the door, and fixing a regular weekly slot makes the trip worthwhile for a visiting tutor. In the monsoon, families often agree in advance to switch a class online on days of very heavy rain. Online tutors can also cover specialist subjects and board exam preparation. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Itanagar North (Chimpu & Ganga).fact: The Itanagar Capital Complex region stretches from the Itanagar municipal limit at Chandranagar to Nirjuli.
Itanagar's official municipal ward schedule lists Chimpu, with government offices and an armed police headquarters, as Ward 1, bounded partly by the Senki and Chimpu rivers.
The same schedule lists Chandranagar Market, Chandranagar Colony and Chandranagar Forest Colony, with the Vivek Vihar police point, in Ward 4.
Ganga Market, the shared-taxi (Sumo) counter, the helipad area and the auto stand are listed in Ward 13; H Sector and the Old Ganga Market are in Ward 6.
Chimpu has its own police station within the Itanagar Capital Complex police.
Gekar Sinyi, commonly called Ganga Lake, is a naturally formed lake near Itanagar.
Donyi Polo Airport at Hollongi, which serves Itanagar, was inaugurated on 19 November 2022.

Central Itanagar.fact: Itanagar is governed by the Itanagar Municipal Corporation, inaugurated on 14 August 2013.
The municipal ward schedule lists Bank Tinali market area, C-II Sector and IG Park in Ward 10, and E Sector opposite the AP Secretariat in Ward 11.
C Sector, the circuit house and the Gandhi Market area are listed in Ward 15; P Sector and Zero Point Market in Ward 16.
Niti Vihar has its own police station, alongside PS Itanagar, within the capital police.
Ita Fort, a brick fort generally dated to the 14th–15th century, has its eastern gate near the Raj Bhavan, Itanagar.
Several bank branches are listed at Bank Tinali, Ganga Market and E-Sector, Itanagar.

Naharlagun & Papu Nallah.fact: Naharlagun is a foothill town administered as part of the Itanagar Capital Complex.
Naharlagun railway station (code NHLN), on the Harmuti–Naharlagun section of the Northeast Frontier Railway's Rangiya division, became operational on 7 April 2014.
Trains from Naharlagun include the Arunachal AC Superfast Express to Anand Vihar Terminal, Delhi, and a Shatabdi Express to Guwahati.
The municipal ward schedule lists Papu Nallah, Press Colony, Papu Colony and Papu Hill in Ward 19, and Barapani with Pachin Colony in Ward 20.
Polo Colony and Upper D Sector are listed in Wards 21–22; G Extension and its market area in Ward 28.
Polo Park is named by the capital district administration as one of the area's popular visitor places.
PS Papu Hills and PS Naharlagun are among the police stations of the capital police in the Naharlagun jurisdiction.

Nirjuli, Banderdewa & Doimukh.fact: National Highway 415 starts at Banderdewa, Arunachal Pradesh, and ends at Gohpur, Assam, serving Itanagar and Doimukh.
Banderdewa is a town on the bank of the Dikrong River at the border with Assam and serves as the check gate between the two states.
Nirjuli is a town in Papum Pare district through which NH 415 (formerly NH 52A) runs; the Par River flows by the town.
The whole Nirjuli complex is listed as Ward 29 and the Banderdewa market area as Ward 30 in the municipal ward schedule.
Doimukh is a subdivision and a block of Papum Pare district.
All visitors except Arunachal Pradesh natives need an Inner Line Permit; the capital district's official page explains how to apply.

board_facts.fact: CBSE's official affiliation overview lists the government schools of Arunachal Pradesh among the schools affiliated to the Central Board of Secondary Education, which conducts the Class X and XII examinations for affiliated schools.
School education in Arunachal Pradesh follows the uniform 10+2 structure.
